character.name: Pixel art sprite (32x32 or 48x48) of a dog astronaut on all fours. Wearing a vintage Soviet cosmonaut suit with helmet and backpack. Dog posture natural (quadruped), not standing upright. Rounded helmet, simple suit details, thick gloves/boots. Clean silhouette, readable at small size. Limited color palette. No gradients, no shadows, no anti-aliasing. Side view facing right.
